description: Produce a report ranking the substrate's most-resolved impulse shapes over the last 7 days by resolution volume and per-resolution cost (tokens and wallclock), split by resolver tier. Note: resolver_tier_cost_summary currently reports tier "unknown" and total_cost 0 for all rows in its 24h window — if cost attribution is missing at the source, identify where tier and cost stop being recorded and report that as the blocking gap instead of ranking on zeros.
